title: Battle of Fort Stedman
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Fort Stedman", at revision 1370440964, opens: "The Battle of Fort Stedman, also known as the Battle of Hare's Hill, was fought on March 25, 1865, during the final weeks of the American Civil War. The Union Army fortification in the siege lines around Petersburg, Virginia, was attacked in a pre-dawn Confederate assault by troops led by Maj. Gen. John B. Gordon. The attack was the last serious attempt by Confederate troops to break the Siege of Petersburg. After an initial success, Gordon's men were driven back by Union troops of the IX Corps commanded by Maj. Gen. John G. Parke." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q543094, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1865 battle of the American Civil War during the Siege of Petersburg". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
